title: The Quiet Kitchen
author: Juniper Thackeray
blurb: Paloma Blackwood, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
